root_motivation: I want a single-purpose, weekly desk companion that composes a short letter from the past week's signals and renders it to a 400x300 grayscale PNG suitable for a Waveshare 4.2-inch e-ink panel on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W. The letter must be grounded in what actually happened that week, so confidant reads the cadence substrate's `daily` records as primary intake and records each emitted letter as a `weekly` cadence record. v0.2 ships composer + render + cadence-bind plumbing in one slice; the Claude API path, the hardware deployment, and PIR/sleep logic are deferred.
user_persona: Joe Yen, solo operator, running confidant locally on his Linux laptop. Invoked weekly (eventually by cron) to compose a letter and produce a Markdown + PNG pair; the PNG is pushed to a desk-side RPi Zero via scp. No multi-user, no network call inside this binary, no daemon.

acceptance_criteria.description: Workspace builds clean: `cargo build --workspace` succeeds with no warnings under the workspace lint config (clippy pedantic as warn, unsafe denied).
`confidant --help` lists the v0.2 subcommands: compose, signals, render. Each prints its own --help. Unknown subcommand returns nonzero with a clap error.

`confidant signals` prints a one-line-per-source summary of available signal counts (recall, git, letters archive). Each source is best-effort: missing bin or missing dir results in 0 (never a panic). Output is human-readable text on stdout; with --json the same counts emit as a single JSON object.

`confidant compose --out-dir <dir>` writes two files: `<dir>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md` (the letter prose) and `<dir>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.png` (a 400x300 grayscale PNG). The PNG magic bytes start with the eight-byte sequence 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A. The date defaults to today and is overridable via `--date YYYY-MM-DD`.

Composition is deterministic given the same signal inputs and the same date: invoking `confidant compose --date 2026-05-24 --out-dir <dir>` twice (with cadence intake disabled to keep the test hermetic) produces byte-identical markdown.

`confidant render <markdown-path> <png-path>` re-renders an existing letter markdown to a 400x300 grayscale PNG. The PNG dimensions are verified by reading back the IHDR width/height from the output bytes.

Cadence intake on (the default when CADENCE_HOME points at a populated substrate): `confidant compose --print-prompt --cadence-intake` shells out to `cadence list daily --since 7d --produced-by daily-receipt --json` and includes a `Daily artifacts this week:` block in the printed prompt, one bullet per record summary. The cadence binary is stubbed in tests via `CADENCE_BIN` env override.

Cadence intake absent: when CADENCE_HOME points at /nonexistent (or the cadence binary fails / is missing), `confidant compose` emits one warning line to stderr (`confidant: cadence intake skipped (...)`) and proceeds to compose without injection and without recording. Exit code 0.

Cadence record: after a successful compose, confidant shells out to `cadence record weekly --produced-by confidant --path <md> --summary <first-line> --sources <ids>` where `<ids>` is the comma-joined ulids of the daily records consumed by intake (empty string when none). The `--no-cadence-record` flag suppresses this step while preserving intake.
`--cadence-intake=false` suppresses intake while preserving the record step (when not also suppressed). The two flags are independent.

Workspace passes `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` and `cargo deny check bans licenses sources`. (Full `cargo deny check` is avoided because cargo-deny 0.18.3 errors on a CVSS 4.0 advisory; the three-subset form is the documented workaround.)

`--cadence-since <duration>` parses a Go-style duration string (`7d`, `24h`, `30m`) and threads it through to the `cadence list` invocation as the `--since` argument. Default is `7d`. Invalid durations produce a clap error.

scope: Single Rust crate `confidant` with one binary and a thin lib for tests
Signal gathering from recall list, git log, and ~/.claude/letters/ archive (best-effort each)
Deterministic template-based letter composition (Claude API path is deferred to v0.3)
PNG rendering at 400x300 grayscale via ab_glyph + imageproc, with a font-less fallback that emits a blank PNG so the pipeline never panics
Cadence intake (read `daily` records) and cadence record (write `weekly` record) via shellout to the `cadence` binary; honors CADENCE_HOME and a CADENCE_BIN env override for tests
CLI surface: compose, signals, render with --json / --print-prompt / --cadence-intake / --no-cadence-record / --cadence-since / --date / --out-dir flags
non_goals: Claude API call to compose the letter (v0.3 PRD; v0.2 ships the deterministic template path)
Hardware deployment to the RPi Zero 2 W (out of scope; the PNG is the bridge)
Cron scheduling (user wires this in their crontab after install)
PIR sleep mode, two-way communication, multi-recipient distribution
Mood ideogram detection beyond simple activity-volume bucketing
Reading session JSONLs directly (cadence is the intended source)
Letter quality improvements; this slice is plumbing + render

additional.deny_subset_rationale: cargo-deny 0.18.3 errors on a CVSS 4.0 advisory; use subset form per user MEMORY

five_whys_trace.a: Because the `letter` CLI already produces past-Claude/future-Claude letters that sit invisibly in ~/.claude/recall/session/letters/, and I want a small dedicated e-ink device on my desk that makes one such letter a tangible weekly object. Confidant is the laptop-side composer + renderer; the e-ink device is downstream.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does v0.2 add cadence intake / record on top of the v0.1 composer slice?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the cadence substrate (PRD-cadence-substrate) just shipped and the daily-receipt bind (PRD-cadence-bind-daily-receipt) is wiring daily records in parallel. Confidant is the first PRD that exercises both directions: it READS daily records from one tier below and WRITES a weekly record to its own tier. Without this bind, the weekly letter is isolated from the daily artifacts even though both are reflective output.

five_whys_trace.q: Why ship composer + render + cadence-bind in one slice instead of an incremental cadence-bind diff onto a still-untested v0.1?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the hand-built v0.1 shipped without tests (scaffold slice). Rebuilding via autobuilder gives every AC a proof receipt at v0.2, and the cadence-bind PRD's `rust-extend` semantics fold cleanly into the rebuild — the cadence intake module is ~50-80 LOC and shares the same CLI surface as compose.

five_whys_trace.q: Why deterministic template composition instead of the Claude API call described in PRD-confidant §4?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the API call requires network egress, a stable voice anchor, and a flaky-test mitigation story that doesn't fit the locked harness. v0.2 ships the deterministic template path (signals drop into a known-good scaffold) so every test is hermetic; v0.3 will wire the Claude API behind a feature flag once we have a recording/replay layer.

five_whys_trace.q: Why a font-less fallback PNG instead of erroring when DejaVu is absent?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the binary is intended for unattended weekly cron runs on whatever machine the user pointed it at. A missing font on a fresh Arch install or a stripped container should not break the weekly cadence; a blank-with-ideogram PNG is a degraded but useful artifact that the user can fix at their leisure.

ambiguities_resolved.question: The PRD is `rust-extend` against an existing v0.1; should we extend in place or rebuild?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Rebuild. The hand-built v0.1 has 0 tests (user discovered today, 2026-05-27); rebuilding via autobuilder makes every AC proof-receipted at v0.2. The hand-built tree is backed up at /home/jsy/wintermute/confidant-2026-05-27-handbuilt-bak/ for reference.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should cadence intake be on by default or off by default?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: On by default. The PRD says 'default: on if substrate exists and contains daily records; off if substrate absent or empty'. Implementation: pass `--cadence-intake` defaults to true; the function silently degrades to off when CADENCE_HOME is missing or the cadence binary fails, emitting one warning line to stderr (AC8).

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should the compose subcommand call the Claude API or use a deterministic template?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Template. Per Why-4: deterministic is the only path that fits the locked harness. The README and CHANGELOG must state v0.3 will add the API path.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should the render subcommand share code with the compose internal render step?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Yes. A shared `render_letter_png(md_text, out_path)` function under src/render.rs is called both by `compose` (after md is written) and by `render` (after reading md from disk). One implementation, two CLI entry points.
